if [ -n "$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" ]; then
  # depot frontend-pin workaround (full rationale in stacks/sayt/sayt.cue)
  find /monorepo -path '*/.bayt/Dockerfile.*' -type f -exec sed -i "1i # syntax=$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" {} \;

docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" down -v --timeout 0 --remove-orphans
s=0
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" up bayt --build --abort-on-container-failure --exit-code-from bayt --remove-orphans --attach-dependencies || s=$?
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" down -v --timeout 0 --remove-orphans
exit "$s"

entrypoint.name: entrypoint
entrypoint.do: case "${ORIGIN#http://}" in "$ORIGIN") h=${ORIGIN#https://};; *) h=${ORIGIN#http://};; esac; case "$h" in "$ORIGIN"|""|*[!A-Za-z0-9.:-]*) echo "ORIGIN '$ORIGIN' is no origin: set it to the scheme and host readers reach the door at, as https://app.example" >&2; exit 1;; esac; set -e -o pipefail; roots=$(caddy adapt --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile | tr , '\n' | grep -o '"root":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u); if [ -n "$roots" ]; then find $roots -type f ! -name '*.etag' -exec sh -c 'set -e; q=$1; shift; for f do h=$(sha256sum < "$f"); printf "$q%s$q" "${h%% *}" > "$f.etag"; done' sh '"' {} +; fi; PRONTO_RELEASE_SCRIPTS=$(cat /etc/caddy/release-scripts 2>/dev/null || true); export PRONTO_RELEASE_SCRIPTS; if [ -f /certs/localhost.pem ]; then export CADDY_TLS='/certs/localhost.pem /certs/localhost-key.pem'; fi; exec caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
